name: lifecycle-small
description: Deterministic 40-op lifecycle scenario: 11 ingest, 4 update, 3 supersede, 2 delete, 20 query; K=10 checkpoints. Synthetic public-domain prose about a fictional research lab (Northbridge Labs). No randomness, no time-dependent content.

args.title: Northbridge Labs founding note
args.text: Northbridge Labs was founded in 2019 by Elena Vasquez. The lab focuses on battery materials research. Its first facility opened in the Harbor District.

args.title: Project Aurora charter
args.text: Project Aurora develops a solid-state electrolyte. The project lead is Marcus Chen. Aurora started in January 2021 with a team of six researchers.

args.title: Equipment register: spectrometer
args.text: The lab operates a Raman spectrometer, asset tag EQ-7741. It is housed in Building B and maintained by the instrumentation team.

args.title: Hiring memo: Dr. Priya Anand
args.text: Dr. Priya Anand joined Northbridge Labs in March 2022 as a senior electrochemist. She reports to Marcus Chen on Project Aurora.

args.title: Project Borealis charter
args.text: Project Borealis investigates sodium-ion cathodes. The project lead is Sofia Reyes. Borealis is funded through a grant from the Meridian Foundation.

args.title: Safety policy v1
args.text: All electrolyte handling must occur in fume hood FH-2. Safety officer for 2022 is Tomas Eriksen. Incident reports go to the safety board within 48 hours.

args.title: Q3 2022 milestone report
args.text: Project Aurora achieved an ionic conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm in Q3 2022. The result was measured on sample batch AUR-118 using the EQ-7741 spectrometer.

args.title: Partnership note: Helios Cells
args.text: Northbridge Labs signed a joint development agreement with Helios Cells in October 2022. The agreement covers pilot production of Aurora electrolytes.

args.title: Equipment register: glovebox
args.text: An argon glovebox, asset tag EQ-8102, was installed in Building A in November 2022. It is reserved for moisture-sensitive cell assembly.

args.title: Annual review 2022 summary
args.text: In 2022 Northbridge Labs grew to 24 staff. Project Aurora and Project Borealis are the two active programs. Elena Vasquez remains director.

args.title: Project Borealis leadership change
args.text: As of May 2023 the project lead of Project Borealis is Daniel Okoye, replacing Sofia Reyes who moved to Helios Cells. Funding via the Meridian Foundation continues.

args.title: Q2 2023 milestone report
args.text: Project Aurora reached 2.0 mS/cm ionic conductivity in Q2 2023 on batch AUR-241. The improvement is attributed to the new dry-room process in Building A.

args.text: The Raman spectrometer, asset tag EQ-7741, was relocated to Building A in June 2023. It remains maintained by the instrumentation team.

args.title: Partnership amendment: Helios Cells
args.text: The Helios Cells agreement was amended in July 2023 to include sodium-ion pilot lines from Project Borealis, in addition to Aurora electrolytes.

args.title: Annual review 2023 summary
args.text: In 2023 Northbridge Labs grew to 31 staff. Project Aurora, Project Borealis, and the new pilot line are active. Elena Vasquez remains director.

args.title: Directorship transition
args.text: In January 2024 Elena Vasquez became executive chair and Marcus Chen was appointed director of Northbridge Labs. Aurora leadership passed to Dr. Priya Anand.
